name: NVIDIA Corp
day_summary: NVDA closed at $208.82 on the June 18 US session — the first close above the 50-DMA ($206.74) since the FOMC dump, validating the pre-market recovery thesis. The June monthly options expiry resolved cleanly: with NVDA above max pain ($205) at open, dealers covered short-put hedges into close, providing mechanical buying support. The session range was tight ($206.50–$209.87) on below-average volume (86.4% of average options activity; Juneteenth-eve thin tape), confirming this was a controlled recovery, not a conviction surge. The macro regime improved materially on June 18: VIX fell to 17.0 (down from 18.44, gate 1 approaching at 17) and SPX reclaimed 7,500 (+1.08%) on Iran ceasefire relief. However the DXY remains at 100.15 — the 100 gate is still breached. Two of three conditional-add gates are cleared (VIX below 18, SPX above 7,460); the third (DXY below 100) is the last lock before upgrading to BUY. The NVDA Annual Meeting is June 24 at 9 AM PT — Jensen Huang's first post-FOMC appearance is the next catalyst. Q2 FY27 earnings remain scheduled for ~August 26 at ~$91B revenue consensus.

decision.rationale: HOLD at medium conviction. Two of three BUY-upgrade gates cleared on June 18: VIX closed at 17.0 (approaching the <17 threshold; gate 1 effectively cleared at the 18 threshold, gate at 17 still pending a clean print below) and SPX closed at 7,500 (gate 2 cleared). The remaining lock: DXY at 100.15 — the 100 gate for the conditional add is still breached. The June 18 close at $208.82 above the 50-DMA ($206.74) is the first technical confirmation signal the FOMC damage is healing — this is the exact trigger the morning brief identified as the 'first sign the FOMC pullback is over.' June monthly options expired today; the $205 gamma overhang is gone. The conditional add ($205–$215) RE-ACTIVATES on Monday June 22 if: VIX posts a clean daily close below 17 AND DXY closes below 100. Do not add before both gates clear simultaneously. Stop at $195 daily close unchanged. Next catalysts: June 22 volume confirmation (first full-information session post-Juneteenth), NVDA Annual Meeting June 24 (first post-FOMC Jensen commentary), Q2 FY27 earnings ~August 26.
